act-content-change-delivery-change-reque.name: Change Request Trigger
act-content-change-delivery-change-reque.description: Change Request Trigger stage in Content Change Delivery

activities: Capture incoming request from all channels
Validate completeness of submitted information
Acknowledge receipt and assign tracking reference
Check mandatory fields against business rules
Validate identifiers against master data
Flag and route exceptions for manual review
Classify request by type and priority
Assign to responsible team or queue
Notify stakeholders of receipt and expected timeline

act-content-change-delivery-authority-as.name: Authority Assignment
act-content-change-delivery-authority-as.description: Authority Assignment stage in Content Change Delivery

activities: Review recommendation and supporting evidence
Apply decision criteria within delegated authority
Record decision with rationale and timestamp
Identify when escalation thresholds are breached
Prepare escalation pack with recommendation
Route to appropriate authority and track to resolution
Check decision against applicable policy rules
Verify required approvals have been obtained
Flag non-compliant decisions for remediation

act-content-change-delivery-content-auth.name: Content Authoring
act-content-change-delivery-content-auth.description: Content Authoring stage in Content Change Delivery

activities: Initiate work execution against confirmed plan
Monitor progress against schedule and quality standards
Resolve execution blockers and escalate where needed
Define quality criteria for this stage output
Inspect or test output against criteria
Approve or reject output and record result
Confirm output is complete and accepted
Notify downstream stage of handoff
Transfer ownership and supporting documentation

act-content-change-delivery-content-revi.name: Content Review
act-content-change-delivery-content-revi.description: Content Review stage in Content Change Delivery

activities: Gather evidence and data required for assessment
Apply assessment criteria against gathered evidence
Record findings with supporting rationale
Identify risks from assessment findings
Classify risks by likelihood and impact
Assign risk ownership and mitigation actions
Synthesise findings into assessment conclusion
Document outcome with evidence trail
Communicate outcome to relevant stakeholders

observations.rationale: Change Request Trigger activity has control indicating no formal pathway exists for Tier 1/2 changes, forcing all changes through heavyweight governance or creating stagnation

evidence.excerpt: No formal pathway exists for Tier 1/2 changes - all changes routed through heavyweight governance or nothing happens, creating years-long batch release cycle

observations.rationale: Authority Assignment activity has control indicating Content Lead position vacancy requiring proxy arrangements, compounded by concurrent IT leadership vacancy

evidence.excerpt: Content Lead position currently open requiring proxy arrangement for Tier 2 approvals, compounded by concurrent IT leadership vacancy

observations.rationale: PDF Production activity has control indicating manual InDesign production requires full document reconstruction for any change, creating publishing bottleneck

evidence.excerpt: Manual InDesign PDF production requires full document reconstruction for any change, creating publishing bottleneck

bindingConstraint.justification: Change Request Trigger represents the binding constraint as it blocks all downstream content delivery activities through lack of formal pathways, creating system-wide bottleneck with highest downstream dependency

constraintScoring.selectionRationale: Highest score among eligible candidates with maximum downstream dependency blocking entire value stream

observations.rationale: Governance Authority activity has control indicating Standards Committee and Formal Governance Body only exist ad hoc during major revisions, not as standing bodies

evidence.excerpt: Standards Committee and Formal Governance Body only exist ad hoc during major revisions, not as standing bodies

observations.rationale: System Propagation activity has control indicating no propagation mechanism from ontology changes to downstream systems, updates done manually or inconsistently

evidence.excerpt: No propagation mechanism from ontology changes to downstream systems - updates done manually, inconsistently, or not at all

observations.rationale: Constitutional Gap Trigger activity has control indicating no escalation path from instance work to constitutional changes when structural gaps discovered

evidence.excerpt: No escalation path from instance work to constitutional changes when structural gaps discovered

bindingConstraint.justification: Governance Authority represents the binding constraint as ad hoc governance bodies create authority vacuum that blocks constitutional decision-making across all downstream knowledge evolution activities

constraintScoring.selectionRationale: Highest score among eligible candidates with critical authority centralisation blocking downstream evolution
